Warning classes

Source: R/warning-classes.R
creel_warnings.Rd

Every warning tidycreel raises has a class, so one warning can be handled in one call without silencing the others. Each carries its own class, creel_warning_<fact>, and the parent class creel_warning. A fact raised in several places has one class wherever it is raised.

Handle one warning for one call with withCallingHandlers():

withCallingHandlers(
  estimate_catch_rate(design),
  creel_warning_mor_truncation = function(w) invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
)

Prefer this to suppressWarnings(), which also hides the warnings that mean an estimate may be wrong: missing period length, rate and effort in different units, sections or cells left out of a total. Errors have a matching family, creel_error_*.

Two classes were renamed to this pattern and keep their old names as well: creel_warn_two_phase_rescale and creel_warn_tost_degenerate.

Information that is not a warning (tier 3) is raised as a message, with a class from the matching family creel_message_<fact> and the parent creel_message; see the Messages section below.

Tiers

Each entry starts with its tier, which get_warnings() also reports:

Tier 1

The estimate may be wrong.

Tier 2

Data quality or precision: worth a look.

Tier 3

Information, raised as a message rather than a warning.

Every warning and tier-3 message is also recorded on the design or estimate the call returns; get_warnings() lists them.

Tier 1 warnings print on every call. Tier 2 warnings print once per design: the first time one is raised on a design it prints, and later repeats on that design are recorded but not printed. A design is new each time creel_design(), an add_*() step or adjust_nonresponse() returns it, so new data print again. Three facts about the design also print once per design although their tier is not 2: creel_warning_no_period_length, creel_warning_pooled_domain_mix and the message creel_message_internal_svydesign. Other tier-3 messages print on every call.

Units and scale

creel_warning_no_period_length

Tier 1. Instantaneous counts were expanded without a period length, so effort is the counts summed over days (angler-days for an angler count), not angler-hours.

creel_warning_no_party_size

Tier 1. No party size was given, so each interview counts as one angler. If interviews are parties, rates are per party-hour, not per angler-hour.

creel_warning_unit_mismatch

Tier 1. A rate and an effort may be in different units (party-hours and angler-hours), so their product may not be a total in fish.

creel_warning_camera_unit_ambiguous

Tier 1. Camera ratio calibration cannot tell angler-hours from party-hours.

creel_warning_catch_is_stratum_total

Tier 1. A catch total supplied to an exploitation rate is a stratum total.

creel_warning_p_period_coverage

Tier 1. The period lengths divided by p_period add to more than 24 hours a day; the period lengths may already include the probability, which would then be applied twice.

creel_warning_p_period_inferred

Tier 1. A schedule had periods but no p_period column, so the period sampling probability was inferred.

What an estimate covers

creel_warning_missing_sections

Tier 1. One or more sections are missing from the count or interview data and are not in the estimate.

creel_warning_missing_rate_strata

Tier 1. Effort cells with no catch rate were left out of a total.

creel_warning_pooled_domain_mix

Tier 1. A total pools over domains the counts do not classify.

creel_warning_zero_catch_excluded

Tier 1. Trips that caught none of a species were left out, so the rate is among trips that caught it.

creel_warning_effort_excluded

Tier 2. Interviews with missing or zero effort were left out of a rate.

creel_warning_harvest_excluded

Tier 2. Interviews with missing harvest were left out of a harvest rate.

creel_warning_trip_duration_excluded

Tier 2. Interviews with a missing or non-positive trip duration were left out.

creel_warning_mor_truncation

Tier 2. 10 percent or more of incomplete trips were shorter than truncate_at and left out of a mean-of-ratios rate (below 10 percent this is a message).

creel_warning_two_phase_rescale

Tier 1. Two-phase totals were rescaled onto the reported catch.

creel_warning_asymmetric_coverage

Tier 1. Count frames in a hybrid design cover different date-stratum cells.

Estimates that cannot be computed or may be unreliable

creel_warning_all_counts_na

Tier 1. Every value in the count column is NA.

creel_warning_zero_fish_total

Tier 1. The estimated number of fish is zero or negative, so a mean or proportion cannot be computed.

creel_warning_no_recaptures

Tier 1. No tagged fish were recovered, overall or in a stratum, so the exploitation rate is estimated as 0.

creel_warning_exploitation_out_of_range

Tier 1. The exploitation rate is outside 0 to 1; its interval is clamped.

creel_warning_estimator_failed

Tier 1. One of the estimators being compared failed.

creel_warning_imputation_convergence

Tier 1. The camera-count imputation model did not converge in a stratum.

Standard errors and intervals

creel_warning_bootstrap_ignores_strata

Tier 1. A bootstrap SE does not resample within the design strata.

creel_warning_bin_vcov_unavailable

Tier 1. Covariance between length bins is unavailable, so bins are treated as independent.

creel_warning_expansion_structure_unknown

Tier 1. Party-size expansion groups straddle the estimation cells unevenly, so the SE of the total cannot be combined from per-cell components.

creel_warning_section_covariance_invalid

Tier 1. The sections' day samples overlap too unevenly for their effort covariances to form a valid variance, so a sectioned total's lake-wide SE and the sections' share SEs are NA.

creel_warning_trip_length_se_undefined

Tier 2. Too few trip durations to give an SE for the mean trip length.

creel_warning_single_interview_strata

Tier 2. Some strata have one interview, so their SE is undefined.

creel_warning_single_day_strata

Tier 2. Some strata have one sampled day, so their variance cannot be estimated.

creel_warning_camera_single_day

Tier 2. A stratum has one paired interview/count day, so its camera calibration SE is NA.

creel_warning_schnabel_ci_upper_unbounded

Tier 2. Too few recaptures for a finite Schnabel Poisson upper limit; ci_upper is a continuous-Poisson stand-in, not a measured bound.

creel_warning_tost_degenerate

Tier 2. Too few degrees of freedom to test equivalence of complete and incomplete trips.

creel_warning_se_divergence

Tier 2. Variance methods disagree by more than the threshold.

Sample size

creel_warning_small_sample

Tier 2. Few interviews behind a rate, overall or in some groups.

creel_warning_thin_rate_cells

Tier 2. Rate cells in a total rest on few trips.

creel_warning_sparse_strata

Tier 2. Strata have fewer than three counts or interviews.

creel_warning_sparse_groups

Tier 2. Groups in a by breakdown have fewer than three observations.

creel_warning_regression_small_group

Tier 2. A group has fewer than three interviews for regression CPUE.

creel_warning_low_complete_pct

Tier 2. Few interviews are complete trips.

creel_warning_low_response_rate

Tier 2. Response rate below 50 percent in some strata.

Data checks

creel_warning_count_validation

Tier 2. Count data failed a check and estimation continued.

creel_warning_interview_validation

Tier 2. Interview data failed a check and estimation continued.

creel_warning_repeated_sampling_units

Tier 1. Counts have repeated sampling units with no count time to tell them apart.

creel_warning_na_counts

Tier 2. Some counts are NA; the effort estimate will be NA unless they are filled or excluded with missing_count = "exclude" (GH #561). Not raised on camera designs, which report the gap at estimation (creel_warning_camera_na_counts).

creel_warning_negative_counts

Tier 2. The count column has negative values.

creel_warning_negative_catch

Tier 2. Interviews have negative catch.

creel_warning_negative_effort

Tier 2. Interviews have negative effort.

creel_warning_missing_effort

Tier 2. Interviews have missing effort.

creel_warning_short_trips

Tier 2. Interviews have effort under six minutes.

creel_warning_long_trip_duration

Tier 2. Trip durations over 48 hours.

creel_warning_counted_not_interviewed

Tier 2. Parties were counted but none interviewed.

creel_warning_party_size_missing

Tier 2. Party size has missing values.

creel_warning_party_size_fractional

Tier 2. Party size has non-integer values.

creel_warning_release_count_fractional

Tier 2. A release count has non-integer values.

creel_warning_catch_unreconciled

Tier 2. Harvested plus released is less than caught for some species-interview pairs.

creel_warning_camera_negative_duration

Tier 2. Camera ingress-egress pairs with negative duration were dropped.

creel_warning_camera_imputed_counts

Tier 2. Some camera counts were imputed.

creel_warning_camera_na_counts

Tier 2. Some camera counts are NA.

creel_warning_high_missingness

Tier 2. High missingness in camera counts in some strata.

creel_warning_dates_coerced_na

Tier 1. Some dates could not be parsed and became NA.

creel_warning_species_unmatched

Tier 2. Some species values match no known species.

creel_warning_unknown_label_collision

Tier 1. A column holds both unrecorded values and the literal label used for them.

creel_warning_catch_totals_diverge

Tier 2. Catch-table totals differ from the interview catch column.

Arguments and calls

creel_warning_circuit_time_ignored

Tier 1. circuit_time was given for instantaneous counts and is ignored; if the counts are progressive, effort is computed the wrong way.

creel_warning_design_type_mismatch

Tier 1. The design is not the type this function expects.

creel_warning_fragile_schedule

Tier 2. Special-period declarations produced a fragile schedule.

Messages (tier 3)

Information is raised as a message, not a warning. Each carries its own class, creel_message_<fact>, and the parent class creel_message, and is recorded like a warning, with tier 3. Silence one for one call with invokeRestart("muffleMessage") in a creel_message_<fact> handler.

creel_message_argument_ignored

Tier 3. An argument has no effect in this call.

creel_message_day_type_from_stratum

Tier 3. A stratum column is used as the day type.

creel_message_high_zero_catch

Tier 3. A high share of trips caught nothing, overall or of a species.

creel_message_internal_svydesign

Tier 3. The internal survey design was accessed; changing it can give wrong variances.

creel_message_large_delta_pct

Tier 3. delta_pct looks like a percentage given as a whole number.

creel_message_mor_incomplete_trips

Tier 3. A rate uses the mean-of-ratios estimator on incomplete trips; complete trips are preferred where available.

creel_message_na_counts_excluded

Tier 3. Count rows with an NA count were dropped on request (missing_count = "exclude").

creel_message_no_subdesigns

Tier 3. No survey sub-designs were found to adjust.

creel_message_nonstandard_estimator

Tier 3. An unusual combination of use_trips and estimator was requested.

creel_message_refused_interviews_set_aside

Tier 3. Interviews marked refused were set aside: their catch and effort are unknown, so no estimate uses them (GH #557).

creel_message_refused_records_dropped

Tier 3. Catch, length or age rows of refused interviews were dropped (GH #557).

creel_message_species_column_missing

Tier 3. The species column is missing, so the species coverage check was skipped.

creel_message_truncation_disabled

Tier 3. truncate_at = NULL turned short-trip truncation off.

creel_message_truncation_skipped

Tier 3. Mean-of-ratios truncation was not applied because the design has no trip duration.

creel_message_zero_counts

Tier 3. The count column has zeros.

creel_message_within_day_independent

Tier 3. Some units on a day were not counted at the same known occasions, so their within-day components are added as independent.
